Lines before the first snippet are not assembled. RH850 only; v850.txt is
shared with V850.

=== 32-bit and 23-bit loads of a label
        .text
        .p2align 1
        mov     hilo(msg), r1
        ld.b    lo23(msg)[r0], r2
        jmp     [lp]
        .data
        .p2align 1
        .space  0x100
msg:    .long   1
